title: Coordinate projection formula
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a set of indices in $ in n$, and let $x$ be a function from $ in n$ to the field with two elements. For any position $q$ among the indices outside $J$, the coordinate of the projection of $x$ at $q$ equals the coordinate of $x$ indexed by the corresponding element of $ in n \setminus J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of $\fin n$
$q$ is an index in a finite set whose cardinality equals the number of indices outside $J$
